title: The Perfect Alibi
author: Wendell Delacroix
blurb: Theo Thackeray, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
